sloka: सुग्रीवेण ततः सार्धम् अंगदः पितरम् रुदन् ।चिताम् आरोपयामास शोकेन अभिप्लुत इन्द्रियः ॥४-२५-४९॥
transliteration: sugrīveṇa tataḥ sārdham aṁgadaḥ pitaram rudan ।citām āropayāmāsa śokena abhipluta indriyaḥ ॥4-25-49॥

translations.english: Overwhelmed with sorrow, he offered fire to the father who had set out on a long journey (to heaven). As per tradition he went round the pyre anteclock wise.
